svg.title: Comparative boxplots and radar chart
svg.desc: Figure contains a legend at top left, four horizontally aligned framed statistical panels for Camera Pose Rotation, Depth, Flow Magnitude and Brightness, and a radar chart at right. Each panel uses colored boxplots for HD-Epic, Walking Tours, Anonymous Lives Dataset, Other and K400, with open circles for means and black bars for medians.

g.desc: Legend frame lists the five dataset colors, followed by open-circle mean and black-line median keys.

Camera Pose Rotation panel. Origin is the visible axes frame; title above, y-axis in logarithmic degrees to the left, categories progress left-to-right from HD-Epic through Walking Tours, Anonymous Lives, Other and K400. The layout is horizontally equipartitioned by category ticks.

Depth panel follows the same category ordering as the first panel. The origin is the axis frame; values are logarithmic metres per frame. Walking Tours occupy the higher central band while HD-Epic and Anonymous Lives sit lower.

Flow Magnitude panel. Origin is the framed log axis; categories align with the preceding panels. Boxplots have long vertical whiskers across the log scale, with green and gray series varying more strongly on the right.
Brightness panel. Origin is the linear axis frame scaled 0.0 to 1.0. HD-Epic values cluster near 0.25; Walking Tours occupy higher mid values; Anonymous Lives, Other and K400 appear on the right.
Radar chart at right compares the same colored datasets across labeled object categories arranged around a ten-spoke polar frame. The frame is radially symmetric around the central origin.
